title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme in Borena, South Omo, Addis Ababa and Tigray, implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 4.2: Individuals and communities affected by crisis transition from reliance on relief towards independence. Activities and the objective include conduct participatory conflict analysis, Establish and accompany peace structures to facilitate peace building and conflict resolution initiatives and support community dialogues, peace conference etc. So, communities in conflict affected areas have increased capacity for conflict resolution and promoting peaceful coexistence. Programmes are in partnership with Sodo Catholic Secretariat and Association of Pastoralist community for change ---- The principal focus of this objective is:- Establish new systems & structures through which groups, communities or people can lead the response through an active and influential role in shaping decisions that affect their lives- Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys- Compensate for past discrimination
